method: Surface records were confirmed from files listed in the DMPV3 FULL_READ_MANIFEST. The generated all-surface structural inventory was used only for navigation.
limitation_statement: This file is a surface-specific active-code Atlas slice, not acceptance of the generated all-surface active-code Atlas as semantic truth.
surface_limitation: This pass adjudicates canonical DMPV3 packet carriage and extension merge guards only. It does not adjudicate every upstream producer, downstream consumer, capital path, broker path, or source-time semantic surface.

records.title: DMPV3 packets use one canonical envelope and bounded producer-role grammar
records.observed_behaviour_from_read_evidence: DMPV3 carriage uses DmpV3Envelope and build_dmp_v3_envelope_kwargs to emit canonical packet fields, producer identity, lineage, validation, summary, and nvda extension metadata. DmpPacketBuilder delegates concrete packet roles to that canonical builder rather than inventing separate packet grammars.
records.test_first_gap_or_action: The existing Tier A packet family already covered canonical shell, role grammar, lineage, explicit extensions, and prepared/review bounded roles. This pass extended that existing family before source repair to cover canonical schema-identifier immutability under extension merge.
adjudication_notes: The generated all-surface active-code Atlas was not used as semantic proof.
The DMPV3 FULL_READ_MANIFEST records the files relied on for this surface pass.
limitations: This record does not claim source-time semantics, capital deployment, external API ingress, or downstream placement surfaces are adjudicated.
This record does not prove every DMPV3 producer in the repo is semantically complete.

records.title: DMPV3 nvda extension merge preserves canonical schema identifiers after test-first repair
records.observed_behaviour_from_read_evidence: Caller-supplied dmpextensions may preserve additional nvda execution context, but can no longer replace repo-owned canonical schema identifiers for payload model name, payload module path, or output model name.
records.test_first_gap_or_action: The new Tier A assertion initially failed because dmpextensions could overwrite canonical schema identifiers. The bounded source repair restores canonical schema_identifiers after merging custom extensions while leaving extra extension context available.
adjudication_notes: The repair is confined to src/nvda_desk/contracts/packets.py and does not alter packet producer APIs or downstream consumers.
The test protects the DMPV3 extension law that extensions must not replace canonical repo-owned metadata.
limitations: This pass does not adjudicate semantic dependency overwrite policy beyond the schema-identifier guard.
This pass does not open runtime trading, broker, or capital deployment behaviour.
